title: typo3-shadcn-content-elements: the skill at work
description: shadcn presets as Fluid elements with semantic tokens. Recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab: the skill’s read-only audit of the Desiderio elements. Then a pricing page switches its preset in the browser and turns on dark mode in the header. Narrated, with English captions.
alt: Film, 47 seconds: the typo3-shadcn-content-elements agent skill. Its audit checks 244 TYPO3 content elements, and a colour scan finds no raw value in their templates. A pricing page follows a preset switch and dark mode. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: shad C N ships as React. TYPO3 renders Fluid.
You ask to move hardcoded colours to semantic tokens.
The audit checks all 244 elements, and the colour scan finds no raw value left.
Switch the preset, switch to dark mode: every element follows.
No React at runtime. Tokens, not colours, in every template.
